title: Leveraging Creative-Process Theories to Enrich a Corpus of Artists' Letters through Annotation Schemes
description: Code, model outputs and derived data for a study that applies four annotation schemes based on published theories of the creative process, with brief clarifying notes where needed, to a sentence-level corpus of letters in which four creators write about work in progress. An offline script recomputes the figures in the paper that rest only on the model annotators' labels.
